interestingFacts: India is the world’s largest democracy and one of the oldest civilizations. It is home to over 22 official languages and thousands of cultures.
The USA has the largest economy in the world. It is known for technological innovation and cultural influence through movies and music.
China has the longest continuous history of any civilization. The Great Wall is one of the most famous man-made structures on Earth.
Brazil is home to the Amazon Rainforest, often called the lungs of the planet. It has won the FIFA World Cup more times than any other country.
Japan blends ancient traditions with cutting-edge technology. It has one of the highest life expectancies in the world.
Germany is known for its engineering excellence and strong economy. It has over 1,500 varieties of sausages and famous Oktoberfest celebrations.
Australia is both a country and a continent. It is home to unique wildlife like kangaroos and koalas found nowhere else.
France is the most visited country in the world. It is famous for its cuisine, art, fashion, and iconic landmarks like the Eiffel Tower.
Russia is the largest country by land area. It spans 11 time zones and has a rich cultural heritage in literature, music, and ballet.
